note: Attack type against armour type: the final damage factor of a weapon hit, after the armour curve (combat.rs scale_hit). The
armour types are small, medium, large, fort, normal, hero, divine and unarmored (6.88g unit.ini defType none), in the order of
misc.ini's DamageBonus lists; a unit(...) line names its weapon's attack type (damage_type) and its armour (size). Factors are
Q16 (65536 = 1.0); a pair that is 1.0 has no row.
Sources: 6.88g misc.ini:23-31 sets Chaos, Magic, Normal, Pierce and Siege. The hero attack row is the Warcraft III custom-game
default (tools/w3x2lni/data/enUS-1.27.1/mpq/Custom_V1/Units/MiscGame.txt DamageBonusHero), which the map does not override.
Not carried: DamageBonusSpells (hero 0.75, same default) is the damage of engine-run abilities, which the pack's ability
damage does not route through an attack type; the script's own spell damage uses the Hero attack type (war3map.j tw 4235-4279).
Spells: the damage of engine-run abilities (DamageBonusSpells, hero 0.75; the other columns are UNVERIFIED and left at 1.0).
